title: Multi-Agent Research Build Roadmap
principles: Use multi-agent debate only when real perspective tension exists.
Keep raw transcript, synthesis, claims-to-check, and operator readout separate.
Never auto-promote agent opinions into Obsidian, LIONCOM, Room16, or public artifacts.
Avoid AGPL/MiroFish code reuse unless a separate license decision is made.
Start with internal use and pilot evidence before UI, LIONCOM, or productization.
Do not version raw scenario sandbox outputs; preserve durable learnings in Vault notes and roadmap artifacts.

phases.name: Fundament sichern
phases.gate: Skill validator green, first smoke has empty_turns=0 and error_turns=0.
outputs: Legacy scenario_sandbox_debate.py removed in favor of the validated skill runner
Raw outputs/scenario_sandbox artifacts treated as local-only test evidence

phases.name: Runner produktionsnah haerten
tasks: Expand health checks for empty turns, token caps, model errors, missing sources, and invalid config.
Add offline tests for config, custom agents, and health evaluation.
phases.gate: Compile green, skill validator green, offline tests green, one real Ollama smoke green.

phases.name: Kontextpaket-Builder bauen
tasks: Separate facts, assumptions, and open questions.
Warn when research or website runs have no sources.
Create templates for website reviews, market research, product ideas, and system decisions.
phases.gate: Context pack can be built without LLM and warns on weak source basis.

phases.name: Synthese und Claim Review schaerfen
tasks: Classify claims as factual, inference, persona_preference, unsupported, or risky_public_claim.
Block done state when Claims to Check is missing.
phases.gate: No run is considered complete without claims-to-check and candidate_only status.

phases.name: Interne Pilotserie
pilot_types: Room16/Quellwert internal review simulation without financial decision
phases.gate: 5 of 5 technical internal pilots completed green; qualitative fixes were generated and applied.

phases.name: Vivi/Codex Arbeitsintegration
tasks: Update routing notes if pilot evidence changes usage rules.
Ensure Vivi/Codex can explain why multi-agent is or is not appropriate.
phases.gate: A new task can be routed into or away from multi-agent mode with a clear reason.

phases.name: Separate interne Scenario-Sandbox-App pruefen
phases.gate: Build only if pilots show repeated need for UI, run comparison, and operator review.

phases.name: Optionaler LIONCOM-Einbau
phases.estimated_effort: 1-2 days for minimal adapter after P6
phases.gate: Only after stable output contract, health checks, operator demand, and runtime verifier are defined.

phases.name: Externe Produktisierung
phases.gate: At least 3 paid pilots, repeatable delivery template, clear price anchor, and privacy/legal scope.

completed_tasks: P1: Added offline tests for config, custom agents, and health checks.
P2: Added context pack builder and templates.
P4: Ran five technical internal DeepSeek pilots.
Decision after pilots: skill/CLI now, separate app and LIONCOM adapter deferred.
stop_conditions: Pilots do not clearly outperform single-model reports.
Health or claim problems remain too high.
The process creates more meta-work than decision value.
LIONCOM integration is driven by completeness rather than real operator need.
